title: Oxford Reading Tree Read With Biff, Chip, and Kipper: First Stories: Level 3. Super Dad
synopsis: In this story, the main characters Biff, Chip, and Kipper are excited as they discover how their dad becomes a superhero in their eyes. It’s a fun and light-hearted tale where the children watch their father perform seemingly extraordinary acts, from solving problems to helping out around the house. The story highlights the admiration the kids have for their dad and how, through their eyes, even ordinary tasks can seem super!
